data.group: Custodian Guard with Adrasite and Pyrithite Spears
data.summary: One time per battle, as your **[Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase)** begins, this unit may activate this ability. For the rest of that phase, its models’ ranged weapons gain both **[[IGNORES COVER]](vsdata:weapon-ability/ignores-cover)** and **[[LETHAL HITS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/lethal-hits)**.
